reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The Helm options `hubble.tls.server.cert`, `hubble.tls.server.key`, `hubble.relay.tls.client.cert`, `hubble.relay.tls.client.key`, `hubble.relay.tls.server.cer…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: These Helm options still work in 1.17.0 but are deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
consequence.remediation: Move the TLS certificates and keys into Secrets and point to them with the associated existingSecret options (e.g. hubble.tls.server.existingSecret, hubble.relay.tls.client.existingSecret, hubble.relay.tls.server.existingSecret, hubble.ui.tls.client.existingSecret).

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0, eight Hubble TLS cert/key Helm options (hubble.tls.server.cert/key, hubble.relay.tls.client.cert/key, hubble.relay.tls.server.cert/key, hubble.ui.tls.client.cert/key) are deprecated in favor of the associated existingSecret options and will be removed in a future release.
